hook: Indiramma Rs 5 lakh cover: *one* application per ration card
hook_b: Indiramma Rs 5 lakh cover: *one* application per ration card
tldr: Telangana has issued enrolment guidelines for the Indiramma Kutumba Jeevitha Bima Padhakam, launched in Siddipet on Nov 19, which gives Rs 5 lakh life cover to one member per eligible household.

beats.what: Only one person per family, ordinarily the earning member the household names, can be enrolled, based on Telangana-issued ration cards.
beats.why: The Planning Department has linked the scheme to ration cards to fix who in each family is covered.
beats.care: Families with ration cards from another district can register at the nearest camp; verification happens in their home district.

causes.label: Scheme launched in Siddipet on Nov 19

event.label: Enrolment rules tie cover to ration cards

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Members can name more than one nominee, with shares in whole percentages adding up to no more than 100%.

cards.q: Should a family be able to cover more than one member?

qs: What happens to families without a Telangana-issued ration card?

facts.t: Nominee shares must be whole percentages and cannot add up to more than *100%*.

viz.verdict: Ration card decides who can apply

steps.e: Household names one member, usually the earner
Ration card number becomes application number
Register at nearest camp; home district verifies
Name one or more nominees in whole percentages

learn.t: IKJBP = Indiramma Kutumba Jeevitha Bima Padhakam, the state's family life insurance scheme

watch: Help desks at enrolment camps will log record mismatches and refer them to officials.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana issues guidelines for ₹5 lakh Indiramma family life insurance scheme; permits only one application per ration card

fact: Telangana's *Rs 5 lakh* family life cover allows only one application per ration card
twist: The ration card number itself serves as the application number.
